text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about, I spotted 
Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky discussing 
something.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—So, is that your favor for today? I don't 
mind at all, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is only natural that you are surprised. 
However, the truth is...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I would gladly accept, but I have 
an important meeting scheduled after 
school today. Could we perhaps reschedule 
for another time?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so... Understood! Then some 
other time, please...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Pre~si~dent~!! Wanna hang out together on 
our next day off?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, Teio. I must go on a site 
inspection for an upcoming event on that 
day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Having spent my days like this, I 
realized that my conduct is hardly what 
one would consider student-like.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, going from meetings straight to 
event inspections isn't exa~ctly very 
student-ish, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I se~e♪ So that's why you want to 'hang 
out like a real student' today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As the saying goes, time flies 
like an arrow; life passes by in the blink 
of an eye. The period spent as a student 
is all the more brief and precious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There will surely come a time when that 
experience proves invaluable. That is 
precisely why... I wish to experience 
things that can only be done right now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have heard that you are well-versed in 
current trends. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'd be glad to help! But if we're doing 
this, we should invite a true pro of the 
student lifestyle♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, President-san♪ Doesn't this 
'Raw Comb Honey Topped Honey Drink' look 
super tasty~?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I understand that honeycomb is a 
novelty, but isn't placing it whole right 
on top a bit difficult to drink?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, these days it's all about being 
Insta-worthy! A-es-the-tic♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Going around hunting for that one 
sparkling moment everyone can vibe with is 
what being a trendy student is all about♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then I shall order that. Having 
resolved myself to this, I must embrace 
every challenge...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah! That one-piece dress is amazing! The 
lace on the shoulders is super cute♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, 'cute', is it... That is hardly a 
word others typically use to describe me. 
...It feels quite refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By the way, would this be considered 
'Insta-worthy'...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It'll totally, definitely look great! Or 
rather... it might even go viral♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Am I to hold this while taking the 
picture...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Let's all take one together and 
post it on Umastagram☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*click*)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Now let's see, just add some hashtags 
and... post♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A hashtag, was it... Something that 
conveys the situation succinctly. In that 
case――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"#DiligenceAndAssiduity" ...Is something 
along these lines correct?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...It's very you, so isn't that nice?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today! Please feel 
free to invite me again anytime♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the pleasure was mine. Bringing light 
to a field unfamiliar to me has earned my 
utmost gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So... how was I? Was I able to act like a 
student?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Ufufu♪ Even that itself is very 
"student-like"!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes having fun, learning, and 
sometimes advancing while worrying over 
things. Don't you think that's super 
"student-like"?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
! ...I see. This very worry itself is a 
precious experience of one's student days.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Exactly♪ Besides, worrying about "wanting 
to be more student-like" isn't something 
you'd ever do once you're an adult, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, so it was darkest under the lamp 
post, huh. As expected of you, Maruzensky. 
I am glad I consulted with you two.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Not at all♪ Just getting to see the 
President enjoying picture-perfect moments 
is more than enough thanks for me~♪
